steps.expected: The P-1132 project page shows Status: Closing.

basis.find: When you open **New proposal**, the period end is set to the last day of the month of the business date.
Each proposal also has an **Invoice date**. It is set to the period end by default.
On the **New invoice proposal** page, select the **Project**.

steps.expected: The project is Closing, so the proposal is created with Status Proposal and no minimum amount message, even though it is worth 42.50 EUR. There is one line: 2026-10-09 Emma Lindqvist - ADMIN, Qty 0.50, Unit price 85.00 (JUN standard rate; Polar Marine Oy has no agreed rates or discount). The amount is 42.50 EUR x 1.0835 (the USD rate effective 2026-10-01) = 46.04875, which rounds to 46.05 USD. Tax is S 25.5%: 46.05 x 25.5% = 11.74275, which rounds to 11.74. Total is 57.79 USD. No reverse charge applies because the customer is in FI.

basis.find: For example, P-1132 Polar legacy closeout is *Closing*. A proposal for 0.50 hours is created as a normal proposal.

An invoice uses the latest rate whose **Effective from** date is on or before its **Invoice date**.

steps.expected: The proposal is deleted and the message "Proposal deleted." is shown. The documents confirm the message, but they do not say which page is shown after deletion, so the Invoice proposals list as the landing page is not settled by the material.

output.summary: All four steps agree with the documents, including the recomputed 46.05 + 11.74 = 57.79 USD for the closing project, although the page shown after deletion in step 4 is not documented.
